name: Calcol
overview: Calcol was a male figure in the Bible identified primarily as the son of Zerah. While his tribal affiliation is not specified, he is noted in Scripture for a comparison with Solomon's wisdom, indicating his recognized status during that time. There are no additional personal details recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Calcol appears as a proper name in Scripture without a provided meaning or divine origin. It is simply the name by which he is known in the biblical text.
familyAndRelationships: Calcol is explicitly recorded as the son of Zerah. Beyond this father-son relationship, Scripture does not provide further family connections or lineage details for him.
scriptureSignificance: Calcol's significance in the biblical narrative is tied to his mention alongside Solomon, highlighting Solomon's superior wisdom compared to him. This comparison serves to underscore Solomon's God-given wisdom by referencing Calcol as a point of contrast. His mention as the son of Zerah situates him within the genealogical context of Israel's history, though his own deeds or roles are not elaborated.
